changes.title: Official CDISC standards-engine or rule-availability change
changes.description: Illustrative change to the pinned Dataset-JSON schema, CORE engine/cache/open-rule source, expected ADaMIG rule-availability state, exchange transport rules or executable-validation evidence boundary.
changes.rationale: Tests whether a standards-tooling change forces review of official version pins, all four exchanged analysis datasets, Dataset-JSON schema/round-trip evidence, CORE cache/rule-discovery evidence and the mutually exclusive executed-versus-NOT_AVAILABLE validation state without propagating into statistical TLFs or treating zero rules as zero issues.
